channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Why This Haryana Engineer Left a High-Paying Job Abroad: Nitin Lalit Turns Plastic Waste into 80% Water-Saving Pots
item.description: A Haryana innovator’s eco-friendly planters recycle plastic waste while saving up to 80% water for urban gardens.

item.title: Two Days After Childbirth, Sripathi From Yelagiri Became Tamil Nadu’s First Tribal Woman Civil Judge
item.description: A young mother from Tamil Nadu’s Yelagiri hills defied social and physical odds to rewrite judicial history for her tribal community.

item.title: Suspected Pakistan Drones Spotted Along LoC and IB in J&K Samba, Rajouri and Poonch Districts
item.description: Suspected drones entered Indian airspace from Pakistan, hovered briefly, and triggered heightened surveillance and ground search operations.

item.title: Shocking Assault In Bengaluru: Woman Arrested After Viral Video Shows Attack on Female Home Guard
item.description: Bengaluru woman arrested after video of her attacking an old female home guard went viral.

item.title: Australia Tightens Student Visas as India and Three South Asian Nations are Moved to Highest-Risk Status
item.description: Australia has raised visa scrutiny for students from India, Nepal, Bangladesh and Bhutan amid rising fraud concerns and integrity checks.

item.title: ‘₹320 at Restaurant, ₹655 on Zomato’: Woman Calls Out ‘Insane’ Food Price Markup, Sparks Online Debate
item.description: A viral post has reignited debate over food delivery pricing after revealing a steep markup on Zomato compared to in-restaurant bills.

item.title: How a Pathankot Beggar Turned ₹10 Donations into 500 Blankets, Bringing Warmth and Hope to Hundreds
item.description: A homeless man from Pathankot turned small donations into 500 blankets to save others from the freezing winter.

item.title: US: Massive Anti-Trump, Anti-ICE Protests Erupt Across Los Angeles Over Civil Liberties
item.description: Thousands rallied peacefully across Los Angeles against Trump-era immigration enforcement, warning against militarisation, masked agents, and alleged constitutional violations.

item.title: ISRO Successfully Launches PSLV-C62 Mission: India’s New Spy Satellite ‘Anvesha’ Enters Orbit To Secure Borders
item.description: ISRO launches PSLV-C62 with the 'Anvesha' spy satellite and 15 payloads, marking a strong 2026 start.

item.title: Bengaluru Fire That Killed 34-Year-Old Techie Exposed as Murder by 18-Year-Old Neighbour After Forensic Probe
item.description: A house fire in east Bengaluru was revealed to be a calculated killing after forensic evidence exposed a neighbour’s violent crime.
